Simulate a full battle between two territories

Source: R/battle.R
rk_battle.Rd

Repeatedly resolves dice duels via rk_duel() until either the attacker can no longer attack (fewer than two armies remain on the attacking territory) or the defender is wiped out. At each step the attacker and defender roll the maximum number of dice permitted by their remaining armies and the ruleset.

Usage

rk_battle(att_armies, def_armies, max_def = 2L)

Arguments

att_armies

Number of armies on the attacking territory (must be >= 2, since one army must remain behind).

def_armies

Number of armies on the defending territory (>= 1).

max_def

Maximum defender dice permitted (default 2L).

Value

An S3 object of class rk_battle: a list with att_armies and def_armies (the starting armies), att_remaining and def_remaining (integers), conquered (a flag, TRUE when the defender was wiped out), rounds (integer number of duels fought) and log, a tibble::tibble() with one row per duel and columns round, att_loss and def_loss (all integer).

See also

rk_battle_odds() for win probabilities without simulating.

Other combat: rk_battle_odds(), rk_duel(), rk_duel_dist(), rk_duel_odds(), rk_odds_table()

Examples

set.seed(42)
rk_battle(10, 8)
#> <rk_battle> territory conquered after 6 duels
#> Attacker: 6 left · Defender: 0 left
